readings: For films with film.rental_duration greater than 5 days, group by film.original_language_id, with NULL as its own group. For each group, calculate AVG(film.rental_rate) and COUNT(*) of films. Return one row containing AVG of the group average rental rates, followed by AVG of the group film counts. Weight each group equally, ignore NULL values in the final averages, return NULL for an average with no groups, and do not round.

For films with film.rental_duration greater than or equal to 5 days, group by film.original_language_id, with NULL as its own group. For each group, calculate AVG(film.rental_rate) and COUNT(*) of films. Return one row containing AVG of the group average rental rates, followed by AVG of the group film counts. Weight each group equally, ignore NULL values in the final averages, return NULL for an average with no groups, and do not round.
queries:
SELECT AVG(group_avg_rental_rate), AVG(group_film_count)
FROM (
  SELECT
    original_language_id,
    AVG(rental_rate) AS group_avg_rental_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS group_film_count
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration > 5
  GROUP BY original_language_id
) AS grouped_films

WITH language_groups AS (
  SELECT
    original_language_id,
    AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration >= 5
  GROUP BY original_language_id
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rental_rate),
  AVG(film_count)
FROM language_groups
